newsitem.title: UK: Boosey & Hawkes marked up after H1 profits.
newsitem.headline: Boosey & Hawkes marked up after H1 profits.

text.p: Shares in UK instrument maker and music publisher Boosey & Hawkes Plc were marked over two percent higher on Tuesday after the company said first-half pretax profit rose 20.7 percent to a record 2.05 million stg.
The shares were marked up 20p to 782.5p in an otherwise flat pre-market. No shares had changed hands by 0727 GMT.

The company said turnover rose to 42.1 million stg in the first half from 40.5 million, with margins and operating profits moving ahead. Chief executive Richard Holland also said he was confident of further progress by the year-end.
